intent: A rough plan for an analytics dashboard page and a settings page. The scribble across Dashboard means 'this needs charts, not sure which yet' — the author wants the agent to propose 2-3 chart types for daily active users and revenue. The scribble near Settings is a note-to-self that Settings should be a modal, not a page. The lone scribble at the bottom is nothing (accidental). The image is a screenshot of a competitor's dashboard used as visual inspiration only. Sticky note 'not sure about this part' refers to the Dashboard content.

mustAsk: what the scribble through the Dashboard means
what the image is / whether it is a reference or content
what the sticky note is uncertain about
what Dashboard shows (its content or data)
mustNotAsk: the stroke width of the scribbles
